summary: Frontend-only retest of the ActivityForm shadcn hour/minute picker passed all requested desktop and 390x844 mobile scenarios. No native time input remains; option sets, selection, HH:MM persistence, preview rendering, reopening, scrolling, and viewport containment were verified.

integration_issues.flow: ActivityForm Select initialization and time selection
integration_issues.issue: React console warns that Select changes from uncontrolled to controlled. Fresh hour selection emits warnings for both time selects; opening seeded data emits warnings for division, hour, and minute. Functional behavior passed, but the state lifecycle is noisy and unsupported by the Select contract.

action_items: Keep each Radix Select controlled for its full lifecycle (for example, use an empty-string value instead of switching from undefined after selection or useEffect hydration).
critical_code_review_comments: ActivityForm passes undefined to blank Select values and later passes strings, causing repeated uncontrolled-to-controlled warnings. The hour/minute behavior works, but initialization should use a stable controlled value.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional acceptance; one non-blocking console warning

seed_data_creation: Used browser-local localStorage only: seeded 2026-08 day 15 with Gongyokai/CCSJC/19:00; separately created TEST_Time Picker Activity with 18:30. No backend or shared data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop verified 24 hour options (00-23), 12 minute options (5-minute steps), selection of 18:30, exact localStorage persistence, schedule preview display, and reopen restoration. Mobile 390x844 verified picker/card geometry, no horizontal overflow, dropdown bounds within viewport, internal scroll viewport (206px clientHeight vs 776px scrollHeight for hours), and selection of final options 23 and 55.
rca_of_the_issue: The only issue observed is caused by value={condition ? selectedValue : undefined} in ActivityForm. Radix Select mounts uncontrolled and becomes controlled after user selection or the loadMonth useEffect hydrates persisted values. Use a stable controlled empty value throughout.
